page.content:
Temple complex of Amun-Ra at Thebes.

How Karnak connects

  • Location: Thebes — Karnak stands in Thebes.
  • Character: Amun — Amun's chief house is the temple of Karnak.

What is Karnak?

Karnak is the vast precinct of Amun at Thebes, expanded by dynasty after dynasty as the earthly house of the hidden god fused with Ra.

Key threads lead to Thebes and Amun.
